title: Boston 311: Will This Request Miss Its Deadline?
summary: Predicts, when a Boston 311 request is submitted, whether it will miss the City's own SLA deadline. Trained on 2025, tested on January–June 2026.
headline: Gradient boosting reached ROC-AUC 0.893 on 137,225 test requests, versus 0.867 for a per-type lookup table.
